properties.name: A proof states what it really does: falsum, cases, hypothesis, cited results, and the eigenvariable fix (phase 3)
properties.rationale: Anthony chose all four phases of the build list on 2026-10-18; this is phase 3 (D rest), answering the trial friction: π+e P2 (no falsum), P3 and Arrow N20 (no kind for a hypothesis), P4 and Brocard B5 (the skill said a theorem is never taken as given while a cited theorem is exactly that; the citation rules conflicted), Brocard B6 (a recalled theorem read holds), Arrow (no exhaustive-cases rule). Item 0 is the Arrow trial's N19, a soundness defect: the generalization check read only `fixes` and never the open assumptions, so reflow2 certified a universal generalization natural deduction forbids (root cause: fact:root-cause-the-generalization-check-read-only-fixes-and-never-the-assumptions-open-at-the-step-2026-10-18). Vocabulary kept small: two enum values (one for any supposition or hypothesis, one for ⊥), two Inference properties, and NO new property for a citation — "cited" is a result kind taken as given, and "verified" is read off the evidence the design already models (a checksummed Artifact that DOCUMENTS it), so a citation is checked by registering its source, not by anyone's flag. "Names v" is the declared-variable model: an assumption's `variables` or `fixes`; one declaring no variables leaves the check unanswerable and the step does not hold (three-valued, as the rest of the module). Every class was pinned failing first on main b32fe1adc (9 core tests, 4 MCP tests). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Phase 3 of the build list (req:a-proof-can-state-a-contradiction-cases-suppositions-and-cited-theorems), plus two soundness fixes. statement_kind gains `hypothesis` (reads assumed / discharged / not_assumed) and `falsum` (reads false, or inconsistent when derived under no assumption; a reductio rests on its derivation). Inference gains `cases` (discharged by the step) and `cases_exhaustive` (node_ref, drawn as a premise; the split holds only while that record holds). A theorem, lemma or corollary taken as given reads `cited` when an Artifact with a checksum DOCUMENTS it and `cited_unverified` otherwise, and what rests on an unverified citation reads conditional (`rests_on_unverified`). loop_status counts unverified_citations, cases_not_declared_exhaustive and inconsistencies. The design-a-proof skill gains a recipe for each. SOUNDNESS item 0 (Arrow N19): a generalization over v no longer holds while an assumption open at the step names v (its variables or fixes) or declares no variables. SOUNDNESS item 0b (cogito, req:a-claim-that-holds-only-under-an-open-supposition-cannot-refute-a-claim-outside-it, added to phase 3 by Anthony): an objection holding only under an open supposition (or an unverified citation) its target is outside contests and never refutes; the same class fixed for replies, detect_defects' attack standing, the delivery roll-up and conclusion_does_not_follow. The schema stamp moves: two statement_kind values.
